behavior_constraints: when --profile is set, the JSON build report contains a top-level `profile` object
`profile` object contains `critical_path` (array of target names) and `critical_path_ms` (integer)
critical_path traces the longest-duration path through the dependency graph in execution order with dependencies first
path weight per target is its `duration_ms`; cached targets contribute 0
only successfully executed targets are considered for the path
ties are broken by preferring the path with more targets, then lexicographically first at each branch
all-cached or empty builds produce an empty critical_path and critical_path_ms of 0
entities.summary: This round adds a --profile flag to build that augments the JSON report with a profile object reporting the longest-duration dependency path and its total weighted time.

instruction_head: Add `--profile` to build. When set, the JSON report includes a `profile` object with `critical_path` (target names tracing the longest-duration path through the dependency graph, in execution order -- dependencies first; weights are `duration_ms` per target, cached targets weigh 0; only successfully executed targets are included; ties: prefer the path with more targets, then lexicographically first at each branch) and `critical_path_ms` (sum of weights along that path). All-cached or empty build
